name: Sort + prefix array + binary search
time: O(n log n + m log n)
whenToUse: Many limits (queries) against the same numbers. Sort and build pre once; then each query is a binary search instead of a walk over nums.

card.signals: "maximum size of a subsequence" with "sum ≤ limit": take the smallest numbers. Many queries on the same nums: build something once and reuse it.
card.pattern: sort, then a prefix array: pre[c] = sum of the c smallest numbers. pre only grows (all numbers are positive), so for each query a binary search finds the largest c with pre[c] ≤ query.
card.coreIdea: After sorting, the best subsequence of size c is the c smallest numbers, with sum pre[c]. So the answer is the largest c with pre[c] ≤ queries[j]. Binary search keeps lo..hi as the counts still possible and count as the largest one that fits.
card.variant: prefix sum with a sentinel (pre[0] = 0, length n + 1), so pre[c] is the sum of exactly c numbers and the answer can be 0. Combined with binary search on the prefix array.

invariant: Inside a query: every count < lo fits (count is the largest checked one), every count > hi does not fit.

legend.text: pre[count]: the answer for this query
